name: Here is a quantum coding exercise. Write a Qiskit program that prepares the 4-qu
task_prompt: Here is a quantum coding exercise. Write a Qiskit program that prepares the 4-qubit W state exactly (using controlled rotations) and verifies it by printing the statevector amplitudes of the basis states with a single 1. Return the entire program in one piece, ready to run without any modification.
